cands.name: Nan Cobb
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, 65. Born in Pompano Beach; co-owner of Cobb's Triangle Tractor (since 1997) and owner of Classic Tents & Events. Eustis City Commissioner 2021-2024; HD 26 representative since Nov 2024.
cands.local_ties: Lives in the Eustis area of Lake County (Wikipedia).

record.text: Eustis City Commission Seat 4, Jan 2021 to June 2024 (resigned to run for the House).
2025 sponsored bills HB 211 (farm products) and HB 791 (surrendered infants) became law, per Wikipedia.

Voted to place Amendment 3 (property taxes) on the ballot and for SB 484 on data centers; voted for HB 1517 (2025) and HB 289 (2026) allowing wrongful death suits over abortions, which passed the House and died in the Senate.

Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
